anime.label: Anime
anime.prompt: Anime scene: [character] stands on a rooftop at sunset, the wind blows their hair and cloak, the camera arcs around, soft shadows, detailed background.

clip.label: Music video
clip.prompt: Music video: [artist] walks down a night street under neon lights, the camera moves alongside, rhythmic cuts between shots, reflections in puddles.

film.label: Cinematic scene
film.prompt: Cinematic shot: [who] [doing what] in [where]. The camera slowly pushes in, soft backlight, light haze, shallow depth of field.

logo.label: Logo intro
logo.prompt: Intro: [your logo] emerges from light and particles on a dark background, a smooth reveal, a soft glint sweeps across the letters.

photo.label: Animate a photo
photo.prompt: [your photo] comes to life: slight natural movement, the person blinks and smiles a little, the camera pushes in almost imperceptibly.

poster.label: Poster
poster.prompt: Poster: [subject], bold composition, dramatic lighting, space for a title at the top, cinematic color grading.

product.label: Product ad
product.prompt: Commercial: [product] in close-up on [surface]. A smooth camera orbit, studio lighting, clean background, highlights on the material.

ugc.label: First-person review
ugc.prompt: A person holds [product] and talks about it to a phone camera, at home, daylight from the window, slight camera shake, natural facial expressions.
